ideas.pitch: A real-time strategic helper and time-allocation dashboard designed for 2-person competitive programming teams.
ideas.problem_statement: Competitive Programming showdown where speed, accuracy, teamwork, and strategy come together across a fast-paced CP round, a non-technical challenge, and the grand CP finale.
ideas.title: CP-Tactician
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the specific format of a 2-person multi-stage competitive programming showdown by solving team coordination and time management gives an edge during fast-paced rounds.

ideas.pitch: An interactive practice arena specifically built to simulate 30-minute puzzle and quiz challenges for CP team qualification rounds.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: 30-minute Challenge consisting of puzzles, quizzes, and other challenges where performance influences advantage in the finale.
ideas.title: QuizWiz-Relay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly prepares teams for the secondary puzzle and quiz elimination round, addressing the exact constraint where performance affects finale advantages.

ideas.pitch: A strategic simulation tool that calculates optimal time distribution and problem selection weighting based on past performance metrics for multi-stage CP competitions.
ideas.problem_statement: Your performance in the earlier stages can directly influence your advantage in the finale. Every second, every decision, and every problem counts.
ideas.title: CP-Advantage-Calc
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on the strategic twist of the event where early round performance grants finale advantages, appealing to the judges' emphasis on strategy.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative code-sharing and pair-programming scratchpad optimized for rapid syntax checks and test-case verification during high-speed elimination rounds.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Fast-paced CP round featuring easy-to-medium difficulty problems with strict anti-plagiarism and team collaboration boundaries.
ideas.title: SyncCode-CP
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the friction of fast-paced teamwork within the allowed team structure, ensuring rapid iteration without violating sharing rules.

ideas.pitch: An individual performance tracker and comparative dashboard for split-teammate final rounds.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 3: Grand CP Finale where both teammates compete individually and strategically use the advantages earned in Round 2.
ideas.title: Finale-Scout
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the unique dynamics of the Grand Finale where teammates split up to compete individually, providing a clear tactical overview.
